scope: Official case (1): single-process, no failure. Restrict policies to a repeated ordered nonempty subset of CNCs, with no repeated CNC within a cycle. This is not the complete space of dynamic policies.
extension: Minimize (-completed washed products, total RGV travel seconds). The travel objective is our transparent multi-objective extension, not a separately required original contest objective.
explicit_model_assumptions: RGV begins at the first track position; all CNCs are initially empty.
A load/unload service occupies the RGV and a CNC for the stated service time. A new part starts processing at the end of service.
An unloaded completed part is washed immediately, before the next RGV move; no washing is needed after the initial empty-CNC load.
A product is counted only when washing finishes by the shift horizon.
Only complete move/service/wash blocks finishing within the horizon are executed; no terminal travel or partial operation is charged.
No process failures, two-stage processing, or noncyclic adaptive policy is included.
